ideas.pitch: Computer vision and machine learning tool to predict and optimize the bite, chew, and mouthfeel of plant-based meat analogues from image scans and extrusion parameters.
ideas.problem_statement: About Hack the Fork: Explore how artificial intelligence can help shape the future of food at the intersection of AI, food technology, sustainability, and alternative proteins.
ideas.title: Alt-Protein Texture AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core focus of the hackathon (alternative proteins and food tech) by solving a major industrial R&D bottleneck using computer vision, appealing directly to NIFTEM food scientists on the judging panel.

ideas.pitch: AI-driven bioreactor monitoring dashboard for mycelium and alternative protein biomass cultivation, predicting optimal harvest times and growth rates.
ideas.problem_statement: About Hack the Fork: Work on real-world challenges at the intersection of AI, food technology, sustainability, and alternative proteins.
ideas.title: MycoYield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses time-series prediction and digital twin concepts which scored 1st place in industrial and tech hackathons, giving judges a familiar yet highly sophisticated technical architecture.

ideas.pitch: LLM-powered nutritional and sensory matching assistant for formulating sustainable, complete-amino-acid plant protein blends from local Indian pulses and millets.
ideas.problem_statement: About Hack the Fork: Explore how artificial intelligence can help shape the future of food and alternative proteins with meaningful local impact.
ideas.title: PulseBlend Formulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages regional relevance (millets/pulses in India) combined with LLM prompt-engineering and constraint solvers, matching the practical commercial viability judges look for.

ideas.pitch: Spatial intelligence network to track and predict pesticide or contaminant drift from neighboring farms onto organic or alternative protein crop fields using weather and GIS data.
ideas.problem_statement: About Hack the Fork: Work on real-world challenges at the intersection of AI, food technology, sustainability, and alternative proteins.
ideas.title: AgriDrift FoodSafety
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds upon a proven winning spatial-farm-defense architecture that successfully integrates environmental APIs and geographic mapping for clear risk mitigation.

ideas.pitch: Computer vision app that scans food processing byproduct streams (like okara or spent brewer's grain) and instantly suggests high-value alternative protein recipes and industrial upcycling pathways.
ideas.problem_statement: About Hack the Fork: Develop innovative solutions at the intersection of AI, food technology, and sustainability with the potential to create meaningful impact.
ideas.title: UpcycleChef AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles food waste and circular economy sustainability—a major priority for institutional food tech research—with a fast, demonstrable image-to-recommendation workflow.
